text:
mira: AM async — quick standup. TL;DR: aiming to cut a small routing-v2 alpha today. What I did: finalized launch checklist and spec updates; pushed copy tweak to docs. Blockers: UX micro-copy needs signoff, and we need two quick ENG reviews (see PRs). Today: get UX signoff, tag reviews, and kick a canary.

sam: on review queue. I'll take PR #4321 (batching config) first. Heads up: the batching change can increase memory pressure at high seq lengths — will run perf. :eyes:

oliver: QA checking in — I can do the canary smoke tomorrow AM but need a stable build/artefact name. Also want a pinned seed for rerunable evals.

mira: build will be `canary-254000-1` once deploy-bot queues it. For eval seed, suggest `seed=2026-03-17`.

liam: SRE notes — if alpha = 10% we should set autoscale min to 2 and enable a short circuit breaker. Example infra snippet to include in the infra PR: ```feature_flag:
  routing_v2:
    percent: 10
    autoscale_min: 2
    circuit_breaker_ttl: 30s
```

dana: UX: I pushed the tiny copy tweak to the spec doc (link in thread). Approveable once you add the alt-label I suggested. No design blockers after that. :white_check_mark:

sam: perf job queued: `./bench/run --pr 4321 --seq 512 --qps 50 --out /tmp/bench-4321.json`. I'll paste results here when done. If perf looks bad we hold the canary.

mira: also need a quick decision on rollout weighting. Proposal: 10% us-west, 5% us-east, fallback to stable. Snippet for rollout policy: ```rollout:
  - region: us-west
    weight: 10
  - region: us-east
    weight: 5
  fallback: stable
```

sam: fine with that. Confirm we have monitoring alerts for token latency and error-rate with a tight threshold for first 30m.

liam: added alert rule — will open infra PR and tag this thread. Rule: latency_p50 > 250ms OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: canary-254000-1 for routing-v2. Status: queued. Triggered by: mira.

oliver: QA will prepare test plan: quick smoke, rerank/regression checklist, and perf sanity. I'll reference PRs in /qa/canary/routing-v2.

mira: great. Action items: sam -> review #4321 + perf run; dana -> add alt-label and approve UX; liam -> infra PR for feature flag + alerts; oliver -> test plan and smoke; I'll coordinate the canary once reviews are in. Tagging owners: @sam @dana @oliver @liam.

sam: I'll ping here when perf finishes. ETA ~3h.

dana: approving copy now.

liam: infra PR created: infra/PR#210 - includes feature flag + alert rule. Linked to this thread.

mira: cool. If perf is green and QA signs off, we'll proceed with canary and monitor first 30m, immediate rollback on threshold. :rocket:
